outcome: early initiation of breastfeeding within the first hour after birth
exclusive breastfeeding for at least six months since birth
continued breastfeeding accompanied by adequate complementary feeding for over two years
cohort: Women in China who had at least one live birth in the five years prior to the 2013 and 2018 National Household Health Service Surveys
finding: While breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding rates for six months or more improved in China from 2013 to 2018, individual and social factors, such as maternal education, income, and mode of delivery, influenced early initiation and continued breastfeeding practices.
mod_finding: Births by caesarean section were associated with worse breastfeeding practices.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with worse breastfeeding practices.
